question: Looking at a photograph, Anjali said, "He is the only son of my father." How is the man in the photograph related to Anjali?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

Given Statement : Looking at a photograph, Anjali said, "He is the only son of my father."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e79d0de2b5244dede68a16861f37b8cce92926c20572d49d5b4b12d8a5ab5a56.png] 

Thus, according to the final family tree **the man in the photograph is brother of Anjali.**

Hence, "Brother" is the correct answer.
